readings: Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) above the overall average bandwidth usage, where the overall average is the mean of `bandusagepct` across all individual telescope records (each telescope counts once, so stations with more telescopes weigh more)? Ignore missing values. For each one, show the station, its average bandwidth usage (the mean over its telescopes), and how much it exceeds the overall average. Return the top 10 by that margin, largest first, without rounding.

Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) above the overall average bandwidth usage, where the overall average is the mean of the per-station average bandwidth usages (each station counts equally, regardless of how many telescopes it has)? Ignore missing values. For each one, show the station, its average bandwidth usage (the mean over its telescopes), and how much it exceeds that overall average. Return the top 10 by that margin, largest first, without rounding.
queries:
SELECT observstation,
       AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
       AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) AS margin
FROM telescopes
WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY observstation
HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes)
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS overall_avg FROM station_avg
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_usage,
       s.avg_usage - o.overall_avg AS margin
FROM station_avg s, overall o
WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
